D cannot open because 'its' is a pronoun with no antecedent in the paragraph.
option_text: These measures have been effective in reducing carbon emissions.

question_text: Arrange sentences P, Q, R, S into the correct order using connector clues. P: The city's air quality has deteriorated sharply over the past decade. Q-P-S-R places Q before the air quality problem it is adding to.

question_text: Arrange the following sentences in the correct chronological order: P. ISRO was established in 1969 with a vision to harness space technology for national development. Q. D (QPSR) places S (2023) third and R (2008) last, violating chronological order.
